connector.name: Uploadcheck
connector.registryDescription: QC videos, podcasts, and clips before upload - timestamped flags with agent-ready repair prompts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package uploadcheck-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.uploadcheck, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: UPLOADCHECK_API_KEY
env.description: Workspace API key from your UploadCheck setup email (get one at https://uploadcheck.app/checkout/)
